verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a compliance/audit platform, so a hosted public trust center is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never documents a public trust page, live external control status, or NDA-gated report sharing. The internal dashboards, monitors and the GenAI DDQ questionnaire autofill are adjacent features, not a hosted trust center, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I get a hosted public trust center — live control status, certifications, and reports shared under click-through NDA — that closes security reviews before they start
